title_en: 5 Boeing 737 MAX 10 Customers With The Largest Orders
title_zh: 5家波音737 MAX 10最大订单客户
summary: Airlines around the world collectively hold over 1,500 MAX 10 commitments.
summary_zh: 全球航空公司总共持有 1,500 多个 MAX 10 承诺。
body_en: An aviation writer, pilot, and flight operations professional who sees aviation from both sides of the cockpit door. With a background in aeronautics, safety, and human factors, she brings curiosity, firsthand experience, and a love of the details that turn aircraft and airports into stories worth telling.

TheBoeing 737 MAX 10 has attracted significant interest from airlines seeking additional passenger capacity while retaining the operational familiarity of the 737 family. On October 20, 2026, the aircraft received FAA type certification, marking a major milestone after years of development and regulatory review.

Boeing reports that more than 30 customers have ordered a total of 1,555 MAX 10s, making the aircraft an important part of the manufacturer's narrowbody backlog. Several major airlines have committed to the largest member of the 737 MAX family, with firm orders ranging from 100 to 167 aircraft among the carriers featured here.

This ranking compares confirmed firm orders rather than combining them with additional purchase options, which may not be exercised. Delta Air Lines and Pegasus Airlines share fifth place with 100 aircraft each, meaning the five ranking positions include six airlines. The distinction between firm orders and options is particularly important when comparing the airlines' actual commitments.
5 Delta Air Lines And Pegasus Airlines Have 100 Boeing 737 MAX 10s On Order Each
Two airlines have made substantial commitments to the largest 737 MAX variant

Delta Air Linesordered 100 Boeing 737-10 aircraft in July 2022, with options for another 30. Announced at the Farnborough International Airshow, the agreement formed part of Delta's plan to modernize its single-aisle fleet and respond to passenger demand. The order gives the carrier a substantial commitment to the largest MAX variant.

Meanwhile, the additional options provide flexibility for future fleet requirements without increasing its current firm order total. The aircraft will be an important addition to Delta's narrowbody operations, offering greater passenger capacity than the smaller members of the MAX family.

Delta has said the 737-10 will be 20% to 30% more fuel-efficient than the retiring aircraft it is intended to replace. Its order also reflects the airline's continued investment in newer aircraft as it works to improve operating efficiency and the onboard experience. Although Delta has options for another 30 jets, only the original 100 firm aircraft are counted in this ranking.

Pegasus Airlines also has 100 firm Boeing 737-10s on order, following an agreement announced by Boeing on December 19, 2024. The Turkish low-cost carrier's purchase consists of 100 firm aircraft and options for another 100, potentially bringing the total commitment to 200.

Pegasus said the aircraft would support its fleet modernization and network expansion plans, with deliveries scheduled to begin in 2028. Its firm order therefore matches Delta's, although the two airlines have different fleet strategies and delivery schedules. The additional purchase options remain separate from the confirmed 100-aircraft commitment.
4 Alaska Airlines Has 105 Boeing 737 MAX 10s On Order
A record-breaking aircraft agreement supports its fleet plans

Alaska Airlines announced an order for 105 Boeing 737 MAX 10 aircraft on January 7, 2026, as part of the largest aircraft order in its history . The agreement also included five Boeing 787 widebody aircraft, while Alaska secured rights to purchase another 35 MAX 10s. The order extends the airline's aircraft delivery stream through 2035, providing a longer-term framework for fleet growth and modernization.

Its 105 firm MAX 10s place Alaska Airlines ahead of Delta and Pegasus in this ranking, while the additional purchase rights are not included in the total. The MAX 10 is the largest member of Boeing's 737 MAX family, typically accommodating between 185 and 210 passengers in a two-class configuration.

Its maximum seating capacity is 230 passengers, while its range reaches approximately 3,100 nautical miles. For Alaska Airlines, the aircraft offers an opportunity to add capacity while maintaining commonality with its existing 737 fleet. The airline's agreement also provides flexibility to adjust its future aircraft requirements, with the additional 35 purchase rights giving it the option to increase its commitment if needed.

Alaska Airlines' January announcement is particularly notable because it combines a large narrowbody order with additional widebody aircraft for its expanding international ambitions. The five Boeing 787s included in the agreement are intended to support the airline's long-haul network, while the MAX 10s will serve its single-aisle requirements. With 105 firm MAX 10s and rights for 35 more, the airline has secured a significant position in Boeing's order book.
3 American Airlines Has 115 Boeing 737 MAX 10s On Order
New orders and converted aircraft make up its commitment

American Airlines announced its first order for the Boeing 737 MAX 10 on March 4, 2024, committing to 115 aircraft. The agreement combined 85 newly ordered MAX 10s with the conversion of 30 previously ordered 737 MAX 8s to the larger variant. This distinction is important when comparing airline order totals, as the 30 converted aircraft were already part of American's Boeing order book before the change.
body_zh: 航空作家、飞行员和飞行运营专业人士，从驾驶舱门的两侧观察航空。她拥有航空、安全和人为因素方面的背景，她带来了好奇心、第一手经验和对细节的热爱，这些细节将飞机和机场变成了值得讲述的故事。
波音 737 MAX 10 引起了航空公司的极大兴趣，这些航空公司寻求增加载客量，同时保留 737 系列的操作熟悉性。 2026 年 10 月 20 日，该飞机获得了 FAA 型号认证，标志着经过多年的开发和监管审查的一个重要里程碑。
波音公司报告称，已有 30 多家客户总共订购了 1,555 架 MAX 10，使该飞机成为该制造商窄体机积压订单的重要组成部分。几家主要航空公司已承诺购买 737 MAX 系列中最大的成员，其中的航空公司已确定订单数量从 100 架到 167 架不等。
此排名比较已确认的确定订单，而不是将其与可能无法执行的额外购买选项相结合。达美航空和飞马航空均拥有 100 架飞机，并列第五，这意味着排名前五的航空公司中有六家。在比较航空公司的实际承诺时，确定订单和期权之间的区别尤其重要。
5 家达美航空和飞马航空各订购了 100 架波音 737 MAX 10
两家航空公司对最大的 737 MAX 机型做出了重大承诺
达美航空于 2022 年 7 月订购了 100 架波音 737-10 飞机，并可选择另外订购 30 架。该协议是在范堡罗国际航展上宣布的，是达美航空单通道机队现代化和满足乘客需求计划的一部分。该订单让航空公司对最大的 MAX 型号做出了重大承诺。
同时，附加选项为未来机队需求提供了灵活性，而无需增加当前的确定订单总数。该飞机将成为达美航空窄体机业务的重要补充，与 MAX 系列的小型成员相比，可提供更大的载客量。
达美航空表示，737-10 的燃油效率将比其打算更换的退役飞机高 20% 至 30%。该订单还反映了该航空公司对新型飞机的持续投资，以提高运营效率和机上体验。尽管达美航空还有另外 30 架飞机可供选择，但本次排名中只计算了最初的 100 架飞机。
继波音公司于 2024 年 12 月 19 日宣布达成协议后，飞马航空还订购了 100 架固定波音 737-10。这家土耳其低成本航空公司的采购包括 100 架固定飞机和另外 100 架的选择权，这可能使总承诺数量达到 200 架。
Pegasus 表示，该飞机将支持其机队现代化和网络扩张计划，预计将于 2028 年开始交付。因此，其确定订单与达美航空的订单相符，尽管两家航空公司的机队策略和交付时间表不同。额外的购买选项与已确认的 100 架飞机承诺无关。
4 阿拉斯加航空公司已订购 105 架波音 737 MAX 10
破纪录的飞机协议支持其机队计划
阿拉斯加航空于 2026 年 1 月 7 日宣布订购 105 架波音 737 MAX 10 飞机，这是其历史上最大的飞机订单的一部分。该协议还包括五架波音 787 宽体飞机，而阿拉斯加则获得了购买另外 35 架 MAX 10 的权利。该订单将航空公司的飞机交付期限延长至 2035 年，为机队增长和现代化提供了长期框架。
阿拉斯加航空拥有 105 架 MAX 10 飞机，在这一排名中领先于达美航空和飞马航空，但额外购买权不包含在总数中。 MAX 10 是波音 737 MAX 系列中最大的成员，通常采用两舱布局，可容纳 185 至 210 名乘客。
其最大载客量为 230 名乘客，航程约为 3,100 海里。对于阿拉斯加航空而言，该飞机提供了增加运力的机会，同时保持与现有 737 机队的通用性。该航空公司的协议还提供了调整其未来飞机需求的灵活性，额外的 35 架购买权使其可以选择在需要时增加其承诺。
阿拉斯加航空一月份的声明尤其引人注目，因为该公司将大型窄体飞机订单与额外的宽体飞机结合在一起，以实现其不断扩大的国际野心。协议中包含的五架波音 787 旨在支持该航空公司的长途网络，而 MAX 10 将满足其单通道需求。该航空公司拥有 105 架 MAX 10 飞机以及另外 35 架飞机的订购权，在波音订单簿中占据了重要地位。
3 美国航空已订购 115 架波音 737 MAX 10
新订单和改装飞机弥补了其承诺
美国航空于 2024 年 3 月 4 日宣布了第一笔波音 737 MAX 10 订单，承诺购买 115 架飞机。该协议包括 85 架新订购的 MAX 10 飞机以及将之前订购的 30 架 737 MAX 8 改装为更大型号的飞机。在比较航空公司订单总数时，这种区别很重要，因为在变更之前，这 30 架改装飞机已经是美国航空波音订单簿的一部分。

title_en: Cathay Pacific Orders 41 Airbus A330-900neos, As New Regional Workhorse
title_zh: 国泰航空订购 41 架空客 A330-900neos，作为新的区域主力
summary: Cathay Pacific has increased its Airbus A330-900neo order from 30 to 41 aircraft, which will replace older A330-300s and grow regional capacity, with deliveries from 2028 to 2035.
summary_zh: 国泰航空已将其空客 A330-900neo 订单从 30 架增加至 41 架，这将取代较旧的 A330-300 飞机并扩大区域运力，
body_en: In August 2024, Cathay Pacific placed an order for 30 Airbus A330neos . There’s now an update , as the airline has just bumped this order by 11 more planes, meaning that there are now a total of 41 of these aircraft on order. Let’s take a look at all the details, and discuss what this means for fleet modernization at the Hong Kong based oneworld carrier.
Cathay Group modernizing A330 fleet with A330-900neos
Cathay Pacific now has a firm order for 41 Airbus A330-900neo aircraft, which are expected to be delivered between 2028 and 2035.

This follows an evaluation of the carrier’s mid-size wide body fleet renewal program, and it will enable Cathay Pacific to modernize its earlier generation A330-300 fleet, and expand its operations on high capacity regional routes. However, the airline is leaving plans for this plane open, and also emphasizes how the jet offers the flexibility to serve longer range destinations.

For those not familiar, the A330neo is the updated version of the A330, featuring improved range and fuel efficiency. The A330-900neo is the larger of the two new variants (with the other being the A330-800neo). The plane has a range of 7,200 nautical miles, plus a capacity for 287 passengers in a standard three cabin configuration.

I think it’s safe to assume that at least most of these A330neos will be equipped with the new Aria Studio business class product , which is expected to be retrofitted on select existing A330s in the coming months. This will finally see the carrier introduce a dedicated regional product with flat beds, which is exciting, though it’s not quite to the level of the long haul Aria Suite business class .
Here’s how Cathay Pacific CEO Ronald Lam described how the A330neo fits into the carrier’s fleet, back when the first 30 frames were ordered

“The A330 is an aircraft type that has been serving Cathay Pacific well for nearly 30 years. These new aircraft will principally serve our regional destinations in Asia, while also providing the flexibility to serve longer-haul destinations as required. The improved fuel efficiency of these A330neos, together with their high standards of comfort, will enable us to further elevate the experience we provide for our customers while also contributing towards our goal of net-zero carbon emissions by 2050.”
How the A330neo fits into Cathay Pacific’s fleet

Cathay Pacific refreshing its short and medium haul fleet with the Airbus A330-900neo makes perfect sense, and is just about the safest, most expected aircraft order that Cathay Pacific could place. For context on Cathay Pacific’s fleet, the airline has
43 Airbus A330-300s, used primarily for regional routes, but also for some medium haul routes
54 Boeing 777s, most of which are long haul 777-300ERs, but there are also some regional 777-300s
48 Airbus A350s, split between the A350-900 and A350-1000 variant
Now Cathay Pacific’s fleet renewal plans are becoming a bit clearer, as the airline has
16 Airbus A321neos on order (beyond the ones already in the fleet), which will be used to expand regional capacity, and to introduce higher frequency service
41 Airbus A330-900neos on order, which will be used to replace the older A330-300s, and to also grow capacity in high demand regional markets
35 Boeing 777-9s on order , which will eventually be used as the carrier’s new flagship aircraft, replacing older 777s; these planes will feature a new first class and new business class product

So a decade down the road, you can expect that Cathay Pacific will primarily be flying A321neos, A330-900neos, A350s (-900s and -1000s), and 777-9s. That seems like a pretty logical fleet development plan to me.

Cathay Pacific now has an order for 41 Airbus A330-900neos, which the airline will primarily use to modernize and grow its regional fleet. The carrier already flies A330-300s, some of which are nearly 25 years old, so it’s logical that the airline would slowly be looking to replace these jets.
Cathay Pacific now has a pretty impressive (but not overly ambitious) order book, with A321neos, A330-900neos, and 777-9s, used for fleet renewal.
body_zh: 2024年8月，国泰航空订购了30架空客A330neo。现在有更新，因为该航空公司刚刚将该订单增加了 11 架飞机，这意味着现在总共订购了 41 架此类飞机。让我们看一下所有细节，并讨论这对香港寰宇一家航空公司的机队现代化意味着什么。
国泰集团使用 A330-900neos 现代化 A330 机队
国泰航空目前已获得41架空客A330-900neo飞机的确定订单，预计将于2028年至2035年期间交付。
这是在对该航空公司的中型宽体机队更新计划进行评估之后做出的，这将使国泰航空能够对其较早一代的 A330-300 机队进行现代化改造，并扩大其在高容量支线航线上的运营。然而，该航空公司尚未确定这架飞机的计划，并强调了这架飞机如何提供服务更远航程目的地的灵活性。
对于那些不熟悉的人来说，A330neo 是 A330 的更新版本，具有改进的航程和燃油效率。 A330-900neo 是两个新型号中较大的一个（另一个是 A330-800neo）。该飞机的航程为 7,200 海里，标准三舱配置可容纳 287 名乘客。
我认为可以肯定的是，至少大多数 A330neo 将配备新的 Aria Studio 商务舱产品，预计未来几个月将在部分现有 A330 上进行改装。这家航空公司最终将推出带有平板床的专用区域产品，这令人兴奋，尽管它还没有达到长途 Aria Suite 商务舱的水平。
以下是国泰航空首席执行官林中基描述 A330neo 如何融入国泰航空机队时，当时订购了首批 30 架飞机
“A330 是国泰航空近 30 年来一直提供良好服务的机型。这些新飞机将主要为我们在亚洲的支线目的地提供服务，同时也可根据需要灵活地为长途目的地提供服务。这些 A330neo 飞机提高的燃油效率及其高标准的舒适度将使我们能够进一步提升为客户提供的体验，同时也为我们到 2050 年实现净零碳排放的目标做出贡献。”
A330neo 如何融入国泰航空机队
国泰航空用空客 A330-900neo 更新其中短途机队是非常有意义的，也是国泰航空可能下的最安全、最令人期待的飞机订单。有关国泰航空机队的背景信息，该航空公司已
43 架空客 A330-300，主要用于支线航线，也用于一些中程航线
54 架波音 777，其中大部分是长途 777-300ER，但也有一些支线 777-300
现在，国泰航空的机队更新计划变得更加清晰，因为该航空公司已经
订购 16 架空客 A321neo（超出机队现有飞机），将用于扩大区域运力并引入更高频率的服务
订购 41 架空中客车 A330-900neos，将用于替换较旧的 A330-300，并增加高需求区域市场的运力
订购35架波音777-9，最终将用作该航空公司的新旗舰飞机，取代旧的777；这些飞机将配备新的头等舱和新的商务舱产品
因此，十年后，您可以预期国泰航空将主要使用 A321neos、A330-900neos、A350s（-900s 和 -1000s）和 777-9s 飞行。对我来说，这似乎是一个非常合乎逻辑的机队发展计划。
国泰航空目前已获得 41 架空客 A330-900neos 的订单，该航空公司将主要用这些飞机来实现其支线机队的现代化和发展。该航空公司已经运营 A330-300 飞机，其中一些机龄已近 25 年，因此该航空公司慢慢寻求更换这些飞机是合乎逻辑的。
国泰航空现在拥有令人印象深刻（但不是过于雄心勃勃）的订单，包括 A321neos、A330-900neos 和 777-9，用于机队更新。

title_en: Cathay Orders 14 More Airbus Jets As Its A330-900 Commitment Grows To 41
title_zh: 国泰航空再订购 14 架空客喷气式飞机，其 A330-900 订单数量增至 41 架
summary: Cathay adds A330-900s and A321neos to modernize its fleet, retiring older A330-300s and spreading capacity across Asia.
summary_zh: 国泰航空增加了 A330-900 和 A321neos，以对其机队进行现代化改造，淘汰旧的 A330-300 飞机，并将运力扩展到整个亚洲。
body_en: Holding a degree in Aerospace Technology, Tom is a certified pilot and a passionate specialist in European aviation. As Content Manager of Simple Flying, he leads the content team overseeing all aspects of Simple Flying's daily output. Tom works closely with airlines around the world to provide topical content and has provided commentary for other outlets, including the BBC. Based in Frankfurt, Germany.

European aircraft manufacturer Airbus today revealed that the Hong Kong-based Cathay Pacific has increased its order for A330-900 and A321 aircraft. The airline confirmed 14 more orders, including 11 A330s, bringing its total commitment for the widebody type to 41 jets. The airline also added orders for three more A321s.

In the aircraft sales war, Airbus and Boeing are constantly competing to announce orders from their airline customers. Both major planemakers have sizeable backlogs for their narrowbody and widebody programmes. Despite this, they are both still keen to add orders to these backlogs.

In a press release issued earlier today, Airbus said the Cathay Group had bolstered its commitment to the A330 family. The group added 11 firm orders to its existing order for the largest member of the A330neo family, the A330-900. The airline already had 30 on order, bringing its total to 41 of the type.

Commenting on the order, Cathay Pacific's Chief Operations and Service Delivery Officer Alex McGowan revealed that the additional aircraft will be used to expand and upgrade the existing fleet, with some replacing older types and others serving as additional new aircraft. This sentiment was echoed by Benoit de Saint-Exupéry, Airbus EVP Sales, Commercial Aircraft.

"Together the A330-900 and A321neo aircraft give the airline the flexibility to match capacity to demand, bringing versatility while benefiting from lower fuel burn and the efficiencies of a streamlined Airbus fleet. We are proud to support the Cathay Group through its exciting next stage of fleet renewal and growth."

According to data from ch-aviation , Cathay Pacific currently has 181 aircraft, of which 14 are inactive. Excluding the new order announced today, the airline has 100 aircraft on order. The airline's order book looks as follows

The airline currently has 18 A321 aircraft, 17 of which are listed as active. All 30 still on order will then presumably be used to increase the size of the fleet, which has an average age of just 3.6 years. The story is slightly different for the Airbus A330. No A330-900s have been delivered yet, and the airline has 43 older-generation A330-300s, six of which are listed as inactive.

With this in mind, the Airbus A330-900 order is likely more geared towards replacing the A330-300s, which have an average age of 18.2 years. The oldest aircraft type in the fleet is the Boeing 777-300. 14 of these aircraft are listed as active, with an average age of 25.3 years. The incoming Boeing 777-9 will likely help replace this sub-fleet.
Credit: Data: Cirium / Graphic: Simple Flying

Despite being a widebody aircraft, Cathay Pacific typically flies the Airbus A330 on shorter legs. According to schedule data from Cirium , the A330's top route from Hong Kong is to Taipei (TPE). This is a flight that takes less than two hours. Looking at the map above, you'll see that other than a single trip to Perth (PER) and a handful of trips to Cairns (CNS), all of the A330 flights this year have remained within Asia.

For example, when you look at London Heathrow Airport (LHR) and New York JFK Airport (JFK), flights have been operated by the Boeing 777-300ER, the Airbus A350-900 and the Airbus A350-1000. body_zh: 汤姆拥有航空航天技术学位，是一名经过认证的飞行员，也是欧洲航空领域的热情专家。作为 Simple Flying 的内容经理，他领导内容团队，监督 Simple Flying 日常产出的各个方面。 Tom 与世界各地的航空公司密切合作，提供热门内容，并为包括 BBC 在内的其他媒体提供评论。总部位于德国法兰克福。
欧洲飞机制造商空中客车公司今天透露，总部位于香港的国泰航空增加了 A330-900 和 A321 飞机的订单。该航空公司又确认了 14 架订单，其中包括 11 架 A330 飞机，使宽体客机的总订购量达到 41 架。该航空公司还增加了三架 A321 的订单。
在飞机销售战中，空客和波音不断争夺各自航空公司客户的订单。两家主要飞机制造商的窄体和宽体项目都有大量积压订单。尽管如此，他们仍然热衷于增加这些积压订单。

考虑到这一点，空客 A330-900 订单可能更适合取代平均机龄为 18.2 年的 A330-300。机队中最古老的机型是波音 777-300。其中 14 架飞机被列为现役飞机，平均机龄为 25.3 年。即将到来的波音 777-9 可能会帮助取代这个子机队。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. Breeze Airways first flew to Raleigh-Durham in February 2023, with the North Carolina airport quickly becoming a critical part of the fast-growing airline's network. This is influenced by the so-called Research Triangle region being among the fastest-growing areas of the US.

For all of 2026, Cirium Diio data shows that Raleigh-Durham is Breeze's most-served airport for flights. However, from January 2027, Tampa will gain the throne , relegating the North Carolina airport to the second spot. While subject to change, the latest information shows that Raleigh-Durham is due to rank first again next July and August.
Breeze Added These 12 Raleigh-Durham Routes In 2026

Comparing the carrier's Raleigh-Durham network in 2025 with what's scheduled for 2026 shows that the following routes have all taken off, one in the past few days. To qualify for inclusion, all the markets must still be scheduled for 2027. This article simply summarizes Breeze's development at the North Carolina airport while providing additional context.

The list includes one international market: the ever-popular Dominican Republic tourist destination of Punta Cana. Until 2018, no nonstop flights existed. Frontier operated in 2018 and 2019, followed by American and Avelo in 2025. While American continues to run, Avelo pulled out in January 2026, which spurred Breeze's entry two months later.

Raleigh-Durham has not previously had nonstop flights to several of the places. Breeze is renowned for beginning brand-new routes, with its relatively low-capacity, 137-seat Airbus A220-300s helping. Atlantic City, Bangor, Madison, Orange County, Provo, Tallahassee, and Vero Beach are all new to the airport's map.

Some of the other destinations were served by other airlines in the past. For example, Stewart was part of American Airlines ' network (when the carrier had a hub at Raleigh-Durham) until 1995 and later by Midway Airlines (which also had a hub). San Antonio was served by Frontier in 2018, while others (like Expressjet and Southwest) flew in the past. Midway served Dayton until 2001, while Expressjet flew to Birmingham until 2008.
These Raleigh-Durham Routes Are Coming In 2027

While it is inevitable that more routes will be announced in due course for next year, the following list summarizes what is known as of November 11. Only one of them, Las Vegas, has previously been served by Breeze. The long transcontinental market to Sin City, which covers 1,761 nautical miles (3,261 km), had flights by the airline between September 2023 and January 2024.

US Department of Transportation data shows that the airline transported 10,284 passengers to/from Las Vegas and filled 78.2% of seats. As the load factor was similar to Breeze's average across its whole network at that time, the reason for the very short existence was to do with fares.

The same source shows that the distance-adjusted total revenue per available seat mile was overwhelmingly the airline's lowest across its Raleigh-Durham routes at the time. It was also 31% lower than to Los Angeles, with that route pulled in January 2026. Breeze's return to Nevada will benefit somewhat from the exit of Frontier last August. However, it'll still face Delta and Southwest.
Breeze Plans 44 Routes From Raleigh-Durham In 2027

While subject to change, the airline has scheduled 44 routes from Raleigh-Durham between January and June next year. It'll have well over double the number of routes of any other carrier. However, because most of its links will only have two to three weekly flights, all on 137-seat aircraft, it'll only be the North Carolina airport's fourth-largest operator for both departures and capacity.

Recall that Breeze began flying to Raleigh-Durham in February 2023. Now that flights to Las Vegas are returning, the airline has ended only one route in nearly four years. This was to Los Angeles, with flights available between May 2023 and January 2026. While California's busiest airport is no longer served, Breeze started flying to Orange County, for the enormous LA Basin, in May this year.

title_en: Korean Air Adds Newark Flights From Incheon, Joining United & Air Premia
title_zh: 大韩航空加入美联航和 Air Premia 行列，新增从仁川出发的纽瓦克航班
summary: Korean Air will launch daily Seoul Incheon to Newark flights with a Boeing 777-300ER, joining United and Air Premia on an increasingly competitive route.
summary_zh: 大韩航空将使用波音 777-300ER 开通每日从首尔仁川飞往纽瓦克的航班，加入美联航和 Air Premia 的行列，共同应对竞争日益激烈的航线
body_en: Korean Air has just quietly added a new long haul route, as the airline will be adding service to Newark, New Jersey. What’s interesting is just how competitive this market has become, but it’s logical in the context of what’s going on at the airline (thanks to S_LEE for flagging this).
Korean Air adds Seoul Incheon to Newark flights
As of May 22, 2027, Korean Air plans to launch daily nonstop flights between Seoul Incheon (ICN) and Newark. The flight will operate with the following schedule
KE97 Seoul Incheon to Newark departing 10:00PM arriving 11:00PM
KE98 Newark to Seoul Incheon departing 1:00AM arriving 5:15AM (+1 day)

The 6,896-mile flight is blocked at 14hr to the United States, and 15hr15min to South Korea. Korean Air will use a Boeing 777-300ER for the route, featuring 277 seats, including eight first class seats, 42 business class seats, and 227 economy seats.

This technically marks a service resumption, as Korean Air last served Newark through September 2001, but then suspended flights after the 9/11 terror attacks, and never resumed the flights. This new service will complement Korean Air’s existing service to New York Kennedy (JFK), which typically operates twice daily.

On top of that, Korean Air’s destinations in the United States include Atlanta (ATL), Boston (BOS), Chicago (ORD), Dallas (DFW), Honolulu (HNL), Las Vegas (LAS), Los Angeles (LAX), San Francisco (SFO), Seattle (SEA), and Washington Dulles (IAD).
Incheon to Newark is becoming a competitive market!
Interestingly, Korean Air faces quite a bit of competition in the market between Incheon and Newark. Going back several years, it’s a route that no airline served.

However, that has changed in recent times. In May 2023, South Korean budget carrier Air Premia launched service in the market using a Boeing 787. Then in September 2026, United Airlines launched flights in the market , also using a Boeing 787. Korean Air’s timing is very similar to Air Premia’s in both directions, which isn’t too surprising.

Some people might be surprised to see Korean Air adding flights to Newark in addition to existing service to Kennedy (with no plans to reduce that service), but this actually seems pretty straightforward to me.

Keep in mind that Korean Air and Asiana have merged , and in the coming weeks, the two airlines will even take on the same brand . Historically these carriers were huge competitors, so of course in some markets they’ll be reducing capacity. In other words, the combined Korean Air won’t have quite as many frequencies to places like Los Angeles, New York, and San Francisco, as the two airlines did separately.

That of course opens up the opportunity to serve more new markets, and clearly Newark was identified as one of those opportunities. Also keep in mind that Korean Air operates as part of a transpacific joint venture with Delta, so the airlines can coordinate fares and schedules, and it’s all about the combined depth and breadth of service.

If you’re looking at this from a Manhattan centric perspective, you might be surprised that the airline is bothering to serve both airports. However, service to Newark goes way beyond that, and the idea is that this flight is useful for serving parts of New Jersey, Pennsylvania, etc. Admittedly those flyers likely aren’t loyal to SkyTeam, but from a Korea point of sale perspective (especially with the number of people studying in the region), it makes sense.

As of May 2027, Korean Air will be launching daily flights from Seoul Incheon to Newark, complementing existing service to Kennedy. This means we’ll see three daily flights between Incheon and Newark on three different airlines… that’s quite the step up from the zero daily flights we saw several years back!

With Korean Air’s takeover of Asiana complete, it’s logical that the South Korean mega carrier would be looking at adding some new markets, given the increased connectivity and scale of the operation.
What do you make of Korean Air launching Newark flights?
body_zh: 大韩航空刚刚悄悄增加了一条新的长途航线，该航空公司将增加飞往新泽西州纽瓦克的航班。有趣的是这个市场的竞争已经变得多么激烈，但在航空公司正在发生的事情的背景下这是合乎逻辑的（感谢 S_LEE 标记了这一点）。
大韩航空增加了首尔仁川至纽瓦克的航班
自 2027 年 5 月 22 日起，大韩航空计划开通首尔仁川 (ICN) 和纽瓦克之间的每日直飞航班。该航班将按照以下时间表运行
KE97 首尔仁川 至 纽瓦克 出发时间 10:00PM 到达 11:00PM
KE98 纽瓦克 至 首尔仁川 出发时间 1:00AM 到达 5:15AM（+1 天）
这趟全长 6,896 英里的航班于 14 小时飞往美国，15 小时 15 分钟飞往韩国。大韩航空将使用波音 777-300ER 执飞该航线，设有 277 个座位，其中包括 8 个头等舱座位、42 个商务舱座位和 227 个经济舱座位。
从技术上讲，这标志着服务的恢复，因为大韩航空最后一次为纽瓦克提供服务直到 2001 年 9 月，但在 9/11 恐怖袭击后暂停了航班，并且从未恢复航班。这项新服务将补充大韩航空飞往纽约肯尼迪 (JFK) 的现有服务，该服务通常每天运营两班。
除此之外，大韩航空在美国的目的地包括亚特兰大 (ATL)、波士顿 (BOS)、芝加哥 (ORD)、达拉斯 (DFW)、檀香山 (HNL)、拉斯维加斯 (LAS)、洛杉矶 (LAX)、旧金山 (SFO)、西雅图 (SEA) 和华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场 (IAD)。
仁川至纽瓦克正在成为一个竞争激烈的市场！
有趣的是，大韩航空在仁川和纽瓦克之间的市场上面临着相当大的竞争。几年前，这条航线还没有航空公司运营。
然而，这种情况最近发生了变化。 2023 年 5 月，韩国廉价航空公司 Air Premia 在市场上推出了使用波音 787 的航班。随后，在 2026 年 9 月，联合航空在市场上推出了航班，也使用了波音 787。大韩航空在两个方向上的时间安排与 Air Premia 非常相似，这并不奇怪。
有些人可能会惊讶地看到大韩航空除了飞往肯尼迪的现有航班外还增加了飞往纽瓦克的航班（没有计划减少该服务），但这对我来说实际上似乎非常简单。
请记住，大韩航空和韩亚航空已经合并，在未来几周内，两家航空公司甚至将采用同一品牌。从历史上看，这些航空公司是巨大的竞争对手，因此在某些市场上他们当然会减少运力。换句话说，合并后的大韩航空飞往洛杉矶、纽约和旧金山等地的航班数量不会像两家航空公司单独运营时那样多。
这当然提供了服务更多新市场的机会，纽瓦克显然被认为是其中之一。另请记住，大韩航空是与达美航空成立的跨太平洋合资企业的一部分，因此航空公司可以协调票价和时刻表，而这一切都与服务的深度和广度相结合。
如果您从以曼哈顿为中心的角度看待这一问题，您可能会惊讶于该航空公司竟然为这两个机场提供服务。然而，飞往纽瓦克的服务远不止于此，我们的想法是，这趟航班对于服务新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州等地的部分地区很有用。诚然，这些乘客可能并不忠诚于天合联盟，但从韩国销售点的角度来看（特别是考虑到在该地区学习的人数），这是有道理的。
自 2027 年 5 月起，大韩航空将开通从首尔仁川飞往纽瓦克的每日航班，以补充飞往肯尼迪的现有服务。这意味着我们将看到三个不同的航空公司每天有 3 个仁川和纽瓦克之间的航班……这比我们几年前看到的每日零航班有了很大的进步！
随着大韩航空完成对韩亚航空的收购，鉴于连通性和运营规模的增加，这家韩国大型航空公司考虑增加一些新市场是合乎逻辑的。

title_en: “Light Bites”: American Airlines To Reinstate First Class Meals On Flights Between 700-899 Miles
title_zh: “小吃”：美国航空将在 700 至 899 英里之间的航班上恢复头等舱餐食
summary: American Airlines is restoring fresh First Class food on shorter flights, reviving a pre-pandemic perk as premium competition intensifies.
summary_zh: 美国航空正在短途航班上恢复新鲜的头等舱食品，随着高端竞争的加剧，恢复了大流行前的福利。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

American Airlines is bringing fresh food back to First Class on selected shorter domestic flights, introducing a new menu of "light bites" on services between Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) and John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) or LaGuardia Airport (LGA) in New York. The offerings include smoked salmon, whipped burrata, and poached shrimp, providing passengers with something more substantial than the packaged snacks traditionally available on these routes.

The change introduces a new, intermediate level of catering between snack-only flights and the full meals generally provided on services of 900 miles (1,450 km) or more. It also restores an element of American's pre-pandemic First Class experience, as US airlines compete to attract premium passengers through better seats, lounges, and onboard dining.
What's On American Airlines' New First Class Menu?

According to the airline's November 11 announcement , the 'light bites' will debut this month on flights linking the airline's Chicago hub with JFK and LGA. Passengers will be able to choose between two fresh options, with selections rotating throughout the year. Unlike American's standard First Class meals, the new dishes cannot be preordered, and the selections will only be available to choose from onboard.

The menu includes six potential breakfast dishes and eight lunch or dinner selections. Choices range from familiar sandwiches and fruit plates to more distinctive offerings, including tropical chia overnight oats for breakfast, and blackened chicken later in the day. The complete list of announced dishes is shown below, although only two options will be offered on any particular flight.

The initiative follows other catering improvements, including expanded Pecan Lodge barbecue offerings on eligible Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) departures, refreshed Main Cabin snacks, and enhanced Flagship Dining facilities at Los Angeles. American's Vice President of Culinary Strategy and Operations, Raphael Girardoni, described the new offering as an elevated experience on a popular route
"We want to exceed the expectations of even our most discerning customers, and this new, more substantial menu offering is designed to do just that."
How American Airlines' Domestic First Class Meals Have Changed

American's latest announcement marks a return to a service that first began more than a decade ago. In April 2015, the airline announced improved domestic First Class catering , replacing snack baskets with plated selections on flights of 700–899 miles (1,130–1,450 km). These included charcuterie, hummus with pita bread, and fruits and cheese, accompanied by warm nuts.

By 2019, American maintained a three-tier First Class catering structure for all domestic routes. This meant packaged snacks on the shortest flights, plated snacks on intermediate services, and full meals from approximately 900 miles (1,450 km). Longer flights received more elaborate service, while selected shorter routes qualified for full meals because of competitive considerations. The historical First Class catering arrangements illustrate how much the offering varied by distance.
Plated snacks introduced on 700–899-mile flights
Three-tier service retained, with exceptions for certain shorter routes
Pandemic-era reductions; packaged snacks became standard on shorter flights
Fresh Light Bites return on selected Chicago–New York flights

The pandemic brought substantial reductions to onboard catering, and the plated snacks previously available on shorter services largely disappeared. American's decision to restore them fits its wider premium investment strategy, as the airline seeks to improve the passenger experience beyond the seat itself.
How Does American Compare With Delta, United And Alaska?

American's light bites offering will create a new distinction from Delta Air Lines and United Airlines . They typically reserve full First Class meals for flights of at least 900 miles (1,450 km), with packaged snacks provided on routes below that threshold. Some routes and departure times are exceptions.
Light Bites on select routes; snacks elsewhere

Alaska Airlines stands out by offering freshly prepared First Class meals on flights as short as 670 miles (1,080 km) . Its Pacific Northwest-inspired menus include strawberry burrata salad and lemon pesto gnocchi, with up to five dishes available for preorder. Unlike American's new Light Bites, Alaska passengers can reserve their preferred food before departure, giving the airline an additional competitive advantage.
body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍布 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
美国航空将新鲜食品带回部分国内短途航班的头等舱，并在芝加哥奥黑尔国际机场 (ORD) 和约翰·F·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) 或纽约拉瓜迪亚机场 (LGA) 之间的航班上推出新的“小吃”菜单。这些产品包括烟熏三文鱼、搅打布拉塔奶酪和水煮虾，为乘客提供比这些航线上传统的包装零食更丰富的食物。
这一变化引入了一种新的中间水平的餐饮服务，介于纯零食航班和通常在 900 英里（1,450 公里）或更长的航班上提供的正餐之间。它还恢复了美国航空公司在大流行前的头等舱体验的一个元素，因为美国航空公司竞相通过更好的座位、休息室和机上餐饮来吸引优质乘客。
美国航空新的头等舱菜单有什么？
根据该航空公司 11 月 11 日的公告，“轻食”将于本月在该航空公司连接芝加哥枢纽与肯尼迪国际机场和 LGA 的航班上首次推出。乘客将能够在两种新的选项中进行选择，并且选项全年轮换。与美国标准头等舱餐食不同，新菜品无法预订，只能在机上选择。
菜单包括六种可能的早餐菜肴和八种午餐或晚餐选择。选择范围从熟悉的三明治和果盘到更独特的产品，包括早餐的热带奇亚籽隔夜燕麦，以及当天晚些时候的黑鸡肉。公布的菜肴的完整列表如下所示，但任何特定航班仅提供两种选择。
该举措是在其他餐饮改进之后推出的，包括在符合资格的达拉斯/沃斯堡国际机场 (DFW) 出发航班上扩大 Pecan Lodge 烧烤供应、更新主舱小吃以及增强洛杉矶的旗舰餐饮设施。美国航空烹饪战略与运营副总裁拉斐尔·吉拉多尼 (Raphael Girardoni) 将新产品描述为热门航线上的升级体验
“我们希望超越甚至是最挑剔的顾客的期望，而这个新的、更丰富的菜单产品就是为了实现这一目标而设计的。”
美国航空国内头等舱餐食有何变化
美国航空的最新公告标志着十多年前首次推出的服务的回归。 2015 年 4 月，该航空公司宣布改进国内头等舱餐饮服务，在 700-899 英里（1,130-1,450 公里）的航班上用精选餐食取代小吃篮。其中包括熟食、鹰嘴豆泥和皮塔面包、水果和奶酪，以及热坚果。
截至2019年，美国航空所有国内航线均维持三级头等舱餐饮结构。这意味着在最短的航班上提供包装零食，在中途航班上提供盘装零食，以及在大约 900 英里（1,450 公里）的航班上提供正餐。较长的航班获得更精致的服务，而出于竞争考虑，选择较短的航线有资格获得正餐。历史悠久的头等舱餐饮安排说明了提供的服务因距离而异。
700–899 英里的航班上推出的盘装零食
保留三级服务，但某些较短的路线除外
大流行时期的减少；包装零食成为短途航班的标准配置
Fresh Light Bites 在部分芝加哥至纽约航班上回归
疫情导致机上餐饮大幅减少，之前在短途航班上提供的盘装零食也基本上消失了。美国航空恢复这些座椅的决定符合其更广泛的优质投资战略，因为该航空公司寻求改善座椅本身之外的乘客体验。
美国航空与达美航空、联合航空和阿拉斯加航空相比如何？
美国航空的便餐服务将与达美航空和联合航空形成新的区别。他们通常为航程至少 900 英里（1,450 公里）的航班预订全套头等舱餐食，并在低于该阈值的航线上提供包装零食。某些路线和出发时间是例外。
指定路线上的小吃；其他地方的小吃
阿拉斯加航空因在航程短至 670 英里（1,080 公里）的航班上提供新鲜烹制的头等舱餐食而脱颖而出。其太平洋西北风味的菜单包括草莓布拉塔沙拉和柠檬香蒜汤团，最多可预订五道菜。与美国航空新推出的 Light Bites 不同，阿拉斯加乘客可以在出发前预订他们喜欢的食物，这为该航空公司带来了额外的竞争优势。

title_en: 5 Things Passengers Never Realize About How Airlines Actually Decide Who Gets A Premium Economy Upgrade
title_zh: 乘客从未意识到航空公司实际上如何决定谁获得豪华经济舱升舱的 5 件事
summary: Think upgrades are based on luck? Airlines use algorithms, fare classes, spending data, and loyalty metrics to decide who moves up.
summary_zh: 你认为升级是靠运气吗？航空公司使用算法、票价等级、支出数据和忠诚度指标来决定谁升职。
body_en: Experienced ICAO English Language Proficiency Instructor for pilots and ATCOs and conference interpreter who is passionate about facilitating effective communication within aviation-related businesses. Possess a deep understanding of the aviation industry, including aviation regulations, terminology, and industry-specific communication protocols. Has been working at numerous airshows across Europe since 2014. Being an ultralight pilot in her free time, she also promotes safety and efficiency in aviation operations.

For many travelers, an upgrade feels mysterious. One passenger gets moved to a better seat while another remains in economy, even though both have airline status, travel frequently, or arrive at the gate early. The result is a long list of myths about how airlines choose who gets upgraded, with many passengers convinced that a friendly conversation with a gate agent or a smart outfit can make the difference. But the algorithm behind the upgrade is much more complex.

The reality is usually far less personal and far more data-driven. Airlines use sophisticated ranking systems that weigh factors such as ticket type, loyalty status, upgrade instruments, spending habits, and even credit-card activity. While the exact formulas vary by carrier, major US airlines such as United Airlines and American Airlines have published enough details for frequent flyers to understand how the process really works. Here's a closer look at five things most passengers never realize about how airlines decide who gets a premium economy or even business-class upgrade and why.
Credit Card Spending Can Matter As Much As Flying
Loyalty Programs Reward Spending Beyond The Aircraft Cabin

Many travelers assume that upgrades are determined entirely by how often they fly. However, airlines increasingly reward customers based on total spending, whether that spending occurs in the air or on the ground. Sometimes it means that one expensive long-haul flight will beat many cheap short-haul hops in the final decision for an upgrade. American Airlines is one of the clearest examples of this trend.

Within American's elite-upgrade hierarchy, status remains important , but it is not the only factor. The carrier uses Loyalty Points as a major tiebreaker when comparing passengers within the same elite tier. According to American's published upgrade policies and industry analyses, passengers who have earned more Loyalty Points in the previous 12 months may receive higher priority than those with fewer points, even if both hold the same elite status level.

That means a customer who spends heavily on an AAdvantage co-branded credit card may outrank another traveler who flies more frequently but accumulates fewer Loyalty Points overall. In other words, airline loyalty programs increasingly measure customer value through total engagement rather than simply miles flown. American outlines these upgrade priorities on its official upgrades page, while analysis from NerdWallet and One Mile At A Time explains how Loyalty Points influence upgrade rankings.
The hidden letter on your ticket matters more than most travelers think

While booking tickets with your friends, you might notice that sometimes the ticket price isn't the same for everyone, and various factors drive price differences for passengers booking the same flights and class. This is because airlines use dynamic pricing and revenue management systems, so two passengers can pay different amounts for the same fare class. Ticket prices constantly change based on demand, booking date, remaining seat inventory, route competition, and predicted sales. A passenger who books earlier, or during a fare sale, may pay significantly less than someone purchasing the same fare class later. All these hidden processes may affect your chances of an upgrade later. Airlines track those differences through fare classes that you’re assigned during booking, represented by letter codes that most travelers never notice during booking.

On United, fare class becomes a critical tiebreaker when travelers share the same elite status and upgrade category. According to published United upgrade guidance, economy upgrade priority generally follows the hierarchy of Y, B, M, E, U, H, Q, V, W, S, T, L, K, and finally G fares. A passenger booked in a higher fare class, therefore, receives priority over someone who purchased a more deeply discounted ticket.
United Airlines Economy Fare-Class Upgrade Priority

While many travelers celebrate finding the lowest fare available, that discount can become costly when upgrades are processed. A full-fare Y ticket may cost considerably more upfront, but it often enjoys substantially better upgrade priority than a deeply discounted fare.

But why do airlines reward higher fares? From the airline's perspective, prioritizing higher fares is logical. The carrier wants to reward passengers who generate more revenue on a particular flight. The result is that two travelers with identical status levels can experience very different outcomes simply because one purchased a more expensive fare. Upgrade algorithms are designed to recognize that difference automatically.

The lesson is clear, as in the old saying “buy nice or buy twice”: the cheapest ticket may save money during booking, but it can significantly reduce upgrade prospects later in the journey. Or you’ll simply have to pay from your pocket to get an upgrade.
Premium Economy Occupies Its Own Upgrade Ladder
It can be a strategic move toward business class

Many travelers view premium economy as simply a more comfortable version of economy class. In reality, airlines often treat it as a distinct cabin with its own place in the upgrade hierarchy, sometimes closer to business class than to standard economy.

United Airlines' Premium Plus product provides a clear example. According to published upgrade guidance, passengers already seated in Premium Plus generally receive upgrade consideration before travelers booked in standard economy cabins. Premium Plus fare classes such as O, A, and R are seated ahead of economy passengers when upgrades to Polaris business class become available.

This means premium economy offers much more than just a better seat. It serves as a stepping stone to the next cabin. For frequent travelers chasing premium-cabin upgrades, purchasing premium economy can therefore be a calculated strategy. The higher initial fare may improve comfort immediately while also increasing the odds of moving up to business class later.
body_zh: 经验丰富的国际民航组织飞行员和空中交通管制员英语语言能力讲师以及会议口译员，热衷于促进航空相关业务中的有效沟通。对航空业有深入的了解，包括航空法规、术语和行业特定的通信协议。自 2014 年以来，她一直在欧洲各地的众多航展上工作。作为一名超轻型飞行员，她在业余时间还致力于提高航空运营的安全性和效率。
对于许多旅行者来说，升舱感觉很神秘。一名乘客会被转移到更好的座位，而另一名乘客仍保留经济舱，即使两人都拥有航空公司身份、经常旅行或提前到达登机口。其结果是关于航空公司如何选择升舱对象的一长串神话，许多乘客相信与登机口工作人员或智能设备的友好交谈可以发挥作用。但升级背后的算法要复杂得多。
现实通常不那么个人化，而更多地是由数据驱动的。航空公司使用复杂的排名系统来权衡机票类型、忠诚度状态、升级工具、消费习惯甚至信用卡活动等因素。虽然确切的公式因航空公司而异，但美国联合航空公司和美国航空公司等主要美国航空公司已经发布了足够的详细信息，供常旅客了解该过程的实际运作方式。以下详细介绍了大多数乘客从未意识到的五件事，即航空公司如何决定谁获得高级经济舱甚至商务舱升舱以及原因。
信用卡消费与乘坐飞机一样重要
忠诚度计划奖励机舱以外的消费
许多旅行者认为升舱完全取决于他们飞行的频率。然而，航空公司越来越多地根据总支出奖励客户，无论支出发生在空中还是地面上。有时，这意味着在最终决定升舱时，一次昂贵的长途航班将击败许多廉价的短途航班。美国航空是这一趋势最明显的例子之一。
在美国航空的精英升级等级中，地位仍然很重要，但并不是唯一的因素。在比较同一精英级别的乘客时，该航空公司使用忠诚度积分作为主要的决胜因素。根据美国航空公布的升舱政策和行业分析，在过去 12 个月内获得更多忠诚积分的乘客可能会比积分较少的乘客获得更高的优先级，即使两者拥有相同的精英身份级别。
这意味着在 AAdvantage 联名信用卡上花费巨资的客户可能会比其他乘坐飞机更频繁但总体积累的忠诚度积分较少的旅客排名更高。换句话说，航空公司忠诚度计划越来越多地通过总体参与度而不是简单的飞行里程来衡量客户价值。美国航空在其官方升级页面上概述了这些升级优先级，而 NerdWallet 和 One Mile At A Time 的分析则解释了忠诚度积分如何影响升级排名。
机票上隐藏的字母比大多数旅客想象的更重要

与朋友一起预订机票时，您可能会注意到，有时每个人的机票价格并不相同，并且多种因素会导致预订相同航班和舱位的乘客出现价格差异。这是因为航空公司使用动态定价和收益管理系统，因此两名乘客可以为相同的票价等级支付不同的金额。票价会根据需求、预订日期、剩余座位库存、航线竞争和预测销售情况不断变化。较早预订或在票价销售期间预订的乘客所支付的费用可能会比较晚购买相同票价舱位的乘客少得多。所有这些隐藏的进程可能会影响您以后升级的机会。航空公司通过您在预订期间分配的票价舱位来跟踪这些差异，这些票价舱位由大多数旅客在预订期间从未注意到的字母代码表示。
在美联航，当旅客享有相同的精英身份和升舱类别时，票价舱位就成为关键的决定因素。根据美联航公布的升舱指南，经济舱升舱优先级一般遵循 Y、B、M、E、U、H、Q、V、W、S、T、L、K 票价的等级，最后是 G 票价。因此，预订较高票价舱位的乘客比购买折扣幅度更大的机票的乘客享有优先权。
美联航经济舱票价舱位升级优先
虽然许多旅客庆祝找到最低票价，但在进行升舱时，折扣可能会变得昂贵。全价 Y 机票的前期费用可能要高得多，但它通常比大幅折扣票价享有更好的升舱优先权。
但为什么航空公司会奖励更高的票价呢？从航空公司的角度来看，优先考虑更高的票价是合乎逻辑的。航空公司希望奖励在特定航班上创造更多收入的乘客。结果是，两名具有相同身份水平的旅行者可能会经历截然不同的结果，仅仅因为其中一人购买了更昂贵的票价。升级算法旨在自动识别这种差异。
这个教训很明显，正如一句老话“要么买好，要么买两次”：最便宜的机票可能会在预订时省钱，但会大大降低旅程后期升舱的可能性。或者您只需自掏腰包即可获得升级。
豪华经济舱拥有自己的升舱阶梯
这可能是迈向商务舱的战略举措
许多旅客将高级经济舱视为经济舱的更舒适版本。事实上，航空公司通常将其视为一个独特的客舱，在升级层次结构中拥有自己的位置，有时更接近商务舱而不是标准经济舱。
美国联合航空公司的 Premium Plus 产品就是一个明显的例子。根据已发布的升舱指南，已经乘坐高级豪华舱的乘客通常会在预订标准经济舱的乘客之前获得升舱考虑。当可升级至北极星商务舱时，O、A 和 R 等 Premium Plus 票价舱位将位于经济舱乘客之前。
这意味着豪华经济舱提供的不仅仅是更好的座位。它是通往下一个小屋的踏脚石。因此，对于追求高级客舱升级的常旅客来说，购买高级经济舱可能是一个经过深思熟虑的策略。较高的初始票价可能会立即提高舒适度，同时也会增加稍后升级到商务舱的几率。

body_en: easyJet shareholders approve £5.7bn Apollo takeover - Aviation24.be

easyJet shareholders have approved the airline’s £5.7 billion takeover by US private equity firm Apollo. The Luton-based carrier said 97.07% of votes cast at Wednesday’s shareholder meeting backed the deal. easyJet expects the transaction to close by the end of March 2027.

Apollo agreed to pay 715p per share in August after rival US investment firm Castlelake withdrew from the bidding. Castlelake had proposed 690p per share, valuing the airline at £5.5 billion. Founder Sir Stelios Haji-Ioannou and his family, who together own just over 15% of easyJet, backed Apollo’s offer.
Completion would end easyJet’s more than 26 years on the London stock market. Founded in 1995, the airline has grown into one of Europe’s largest low-cost carriers.
The BBC also reported that easyJet is consulting on proposals that could cut around 50 roles from its 2,300-strong head office team.

body_en: AlbaStar suspends flights and prepares insolvency filing - Aviation24.be

Spanish charter airline AlbaStar suspended commercial flights on 10 November 2026 and said it would apply for voluntary insolvency proceedings. The Palma de Mallorca-based carrier is still in talks with potential investors in an effort to resume operations.

In a letter to business partners seen by Spanish trade publication Preferente , managing director Oriol Hernández said AlbaStar’s debt burden dated back to the pandemic and had been compounded by geopolitical tensions and rising fuel costs. Several potential investors had shown interest, but the airline’s cash position forced it to halt flights before it could reach a deal.

AlbaStar had already undergone a rescue in 2022. According to Aviacionline , Spanish investment firm Sherpa Capital took a majority stake as part of a deal that included a capital increase and a €15 million loan from Spanish development finance institution COFIDES . The shareholders subsequently sought a strategic investor or a buyer for the airline.

Founded in 2009 by Italian and British investors, AlbaStar began flying in July 2010 with a Boeing 737-400. It built a business around holiday and pilgrimage charters, including flights to Lourdes, and had a substantial presence in Italy. It also wet-leased aircraft to other airlines, including two 737-800s to Argentina’s Flybondi for the 2024–25 southern summer. AlbaStar employed about 200 people.
AlbaStar had five Boeing 737-800s, each configured with 189 seats. The fleet was reported parked at the following airports at the time of the suspension.

body_en: Wizz Air shifts Budapest flights from Charleroi to Brussels Airport - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Brussels Airport (BRU) Wizz Air shifts Budapest flights from Charleroi to Brussels Airport

Wizz Air will move its Budapest service from Brussels South Charleroi Airport (CRL) to Brussels Airport (BRU) on 4 February 2027. The airline will end its Budapest–Charleroi flights when the switch takes effect.

The non-stop Budapest–Zaventem service will operate year-round, nine times a week , with one flight each day and a second on Thursdays and Fridays. Belgian outlet Aktualno?ci.BE reports that Wizz Air will use Airbus A321neos on the route.

The move brings passengers closer to central Brussels and the European Quarter. Brussels Airport’s station, directly beneath the terminal, offers direct trains to Brussels-Central in about 18 minutes and two trains an hour to the European Quarter.
Charleroi is still scheduled to retain non-stop flights to Budapest with Ryanair after Wizz Air’s move.

SWISS has postponed the resumption of its Zurich–Dubai flights until after 27 March 2027, the end of its winter timetable. The airline had planned to restart the service on 25 November 2026 but said it had decided with Lufthansa Group to extend the suspension for operational reasons.

Meanwhile, SWISS will restore a second daily flight between Zurich and Delhi from 2 December 2026 to 27 March 2027 . The additional service will operate alongside the regular daily flight and will mostly use an Airbus A340.
SWISS said it would notify passengers affected by the Dubai cancellations and rebook them on alternative flights.

title_en: United Airlines To Finally Bring NEXT Cabin Retrofits To Its 21 Boeing 757-300s
title_zh: 美国联合航空最终为其 21 架波音 757-300 飞机进行下一次客舱改造
summary: Seatback entertainment is among the most prominent upgrades.
summary_zh: 椅背娱乐是最突出的升级之一。
body_en: Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

United Airlines plans to modify its Boeing 757-300 fleet to the United Next cabin standard, bringing seatback entertainment, larger overhead bins, and refreshed interiors to 21 aircraft that average roughly 24 years old. The plan surfaced in a post on Tuesday by aviation analyst JonNYC , who quoted United’s modification notice describing the work. The 757-300 has been the most visible holdout in a program that has already transformed much of the airline’s narrowbody fleet.

The scope is broad. According to the notice, the aircraft will receive new Boeing Space Bins, Panasonic Audio Video On Demand, inflight entertainment at every seat, a full-cabin in-seat power system, new class dividers and cabin headers, and updated United branding, while all seats and monuments will be refreshed. United has not published a schedule, and travelers may continue to face the old cabin until modifications are completed.

Entertainment will be the most noticeable shift for passengers. The 757-300 currently relies on entertainment streamed to a passenger’s own device. That arrangement dates to an earlier reconfiguration, when DIRECTV seatback screens were removed in favor of streaming and power outlets were limited to rows 1 through 23. Installing screens and universal power therefore reverses a cost-saving decision, and one trade publication notes the plan reverses an earlier cabin approach that removed seatback screens from domestic aircraft.

Storage should improve as well. Existing bins are relatively small and often require passengers to place standard carry-on bags sideways. The replacement Space Bins are designed to hold more bags, although whether the 757-300 versions would match that capacity has not been confirmed. Cabin density is unlikely to change, since each aircraft is configured with 234 seats, a layout United adopted when it added 21 economy seats and kept 24 in first class under a plan reported in 2016.

Certification was the main obstacle. The larger bins were not previously certified for the 757, and United had to lead the certification effort because few carriers still fly the -300 model. Delta Air Lines is the only other US operator of the type. A small global fleet offers little incentive for a supplier to fund engineering work, which explains why the program reached the 757-300 only after the Airbus and 737 variants.

Retrofit economics also shaped the timing. United’s broader United Next program dates to a June 2021 announcement that projected 99% completion by summer 2025. That target slipped, and the airline reported in March that 70% of its narrowbody retrofit plan was complete. Against that backdrop, a 21-aircraft subfleet needing bespoke certification naturally fell to the end of the queue.

Spending on cabin hardware generally implies an airline expects to keep an aircraft flying. Some members of the aviation community will interpret the work as a sign that United sees a continuing role for the 757-300 for many years. That view sits somewhat uneasily with earlier expectations. The A321neo and 737 MAX 10 are intended to replace the type, so the retrofit may serve as a bridge while those deliveries arrive, rather than a permanent commitment.

The routes involved are significant. The 757-300s have flown San Francisco to Chicago , Los Angeles to Washington Dulles, and Los Angeles to Chicago. All those routes are long, high-demand domestic markets where inconsistent product is most noticeable to premium customers. Standardizing the cabin also simplifies the airline’s marketing, since customers booking a United narrowbody will more reliably receive the same amenities.

It is important, though, to treat the details as reported rather than formally announced, as United has not confirmed the work yet. The primary source is JonNYC’s post, which reproduces what appears to be United’s internal modification language, and the airline has not issued a public release with dates, aircraft counts per quarter, or final bin specifications. Until it does, the scope is clear, but the timeline is not.

body_zh: Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
美国联合航空计划对其波音 757-300 机队进行改造，使其符合 United Next 客舱标准，为 21 架平均机龄约为 24 年的飞机配备座椅靠背娱乐系统、更大的头顶行李舱和更新的内饰。该计划在航空分析师 JonNYC 周二的一篇帖子中浮出水面，他引用了美联航描述这项工作的修改通知。 757-300 一直是该航空公司大部分窄体机机队改造计划中最明显的顽固分子。
范围很广。根据通知，这架飞机将配备新的波音太空箱、松下音频视频点播、每个座位的机上娱乐系统、全机舱座位内电力系统、新的舱位分隔板和机舱顶板，以及更新的美联航品牌标识，同时所有座椅和标志都将焕然一新。美联航尚未公布时间表，旅客可能会继续面对旧客舱，直到改造完成。
娱乐将是乘客最明显的转变。 757-300 目前依赖将娱乐内容传输到乘客自己的设备上。这种安排可以追溯到早期的重新配置，当时 DIRECTV 座椅靠背屏幕被拆除，以支持流媒体播放，电源插座仅限于第 1 排至第 23 排。因此，安装屏幕和通用电源推翻了一项节省成本的决定，一份贸易出版物指出，该计划推翻了早期从国内飞机上拆除座椅靠背屏幕的机舱方法。
存储也应该得到改善。现有的行李箱相对较小，通常需要乘客将标准随身行李横向放置。替换后的太空箱旨在容纳更多行李，但 757-300 版本是否能匹配这一容量尚未得到证实。机舱密度不太可能改变，因为每架飞机都配置有 234 个座位，根据 2016 年报道的计划，美联航在增加 21 个经济舱座位并保留 24 个头等舱座位时采用了这种布局。
认证是主要障碍。较大的行李箱此前并未针对 757 进行认证，美联航必须主导认证工作，因为很少有航空公司仍在运营 -300 型号。达美航空是美国唯一一家此类运营商。全球规模较小的机队几乎没有动力让供应商资助工程工作，这解释了为什么该项目仅在空客和 737 改型之后才推出 757-300。
改造经济学也决定了时机。美联航更广泛的 United Next 计划可追溯到 2021 年 6 月宣布的计划，预计到 2025 年夏季完成 99%。该目标有所下滑，该航空公司在 3 月份报告称，其窄体机改装计划已完成 70%。在此背景下，由 21 架飞机组成的需要定制认证的子机队自然落到了最后。
机舱硬件上的支出通常意味着航空公司希望保持飞机飞行。航空界的一些成员将这项工作解读为美联航认为 757-300 多年来将继续发挥作用的标志。这种观点与之前的预期有些不一致。 A321neo 和 737 MAX 10 旨在取代该型号，因此改装可能会在这些交付到达时充当桥梁，而不是永久承诺。
所涉及的路线意义重大。 757-300 已执飞旧金山至芝加哥、洛杉矶至华盛顿杜勒斯国际机场以及洛杉矶至芝加哥的航班。所有这些航线都是长途且需求量大的国内市场，其中产品的不一致对高端客户来说最为明显。客舱标准化还简化了航空公司的营销，因为预订美联航窄体飞机的客户将更可靠地获得相同的设施。
不过，重要的是要以报道的方式对待细节，而不是正式宣布的细节，因为曼联尚未确认这项工作。主要来源是 JonNYC 的帖子，该帖子似乎复制了美联航的内部修改语言，并且该航空公司尚未发布包含日期、每季度飞机数量或最终垃圾箱规格的公开版本。在此之前，范围是明确的，但时间表尚不清楚。

body_en: Avianca adds seasonal routes and doubles Bogotá–Barcelona flights - Aviation24.be

Avianca plans to operate more than 126,000 flights and offer over 22 million seats between October 2026 and March 2027. The airline’s schedule covers more than 155 routes across the Americas and Europe, with seasonal services and frequency increases on more than 20 routes.
In Europe, Avianca will double its Bogotá–Barcelona service from seven to 14 weekly flights between 6 December 2026 and 31 January 2027 , offering two flights a day over the holiday period.

In South America, the airline increased Bogotá–Asunción from three to seven weekly flights and Bogotá–Montevideo from four to seven in the final week of October. Both routes now have daily service on 180-seat Airbus A320s. Avianca is also adding frequencies on Colombian domestic routes from Bogotá to Cartagena, Medellín and Cali, among others.
Seven seasonal routes are scheduled to start or resume in December.

title_en: A $1 Aircraft, No Boarding Pass & A Cockpit Seat: Pacific Island Hopping On A Beechcraft Super King Air 200
title_zh: 1 美元飞机、无需登机牌和驾驶舱座位：太平洋岛屿乘坐比奇超级空中国王 200
summary: The Super King Air 200 makes an excellent island-hopping aircraft, connecting outlying islands while also offering excellent passenger comfort.
summary_zh: 超级国王航空 200 是一款出色的跳岛飞机，连接离岛的同时还为乘客提供卓越的舒适度。
body_en: Aaron is an aviation enthusiast and world traveler with a deep interest in aerospace history and technology. He has traveled around the world numerous times, often incorporating visits to aviation museums and historic aircraft collections into his journeys. A native of New Zealand, he is an expert in aviation and maintains a broad interest in a variety of other subjects.

The Beechcraft Super King Air 200 (B200) twin-engine turboprop is popular as a bush plane and as an island hopper, especially for somewhat longer inter-island routes. The Super King Air 200 I flew with is operated as a scheduled passenger flight between Palau and Yap, offering the only connection between the two culturally and logistically linked Pacific islands.

As the flight bypasses Guam International Airport, it is also the only scheduled passenger flight to Yap (a major island in the Federated States of Micronesia) that bypasses the need to pass through US immigration.

During my tour of the Pacific, I also flew round trip on PMA's second B200 on a mission to the outer Yap island of Ulithi. The aircraft is ideally sized as it is the largest commercial aircraft that Ulithi's little airstrip is able to accommodate. Let's examine life onboard the Beechcraft Super King Air 200 and how it is well suited to some inter-island passenger routes in the Pacific.
Why PMA Operates Super King Air 200 Turboprops

In October 2026, I flew from the Pacific Island nation of Palau to Yap (part of the Federated States of Micronesia) on a Beechcraft Super King Air 200. I then flew with the B200 to the outer Yap island of Ulithi on November 2nd. These aircraft are owned and operated by the hybrid charity organization, Pacific Missionary Aviation (PMA).

PMA is a charity company whose aircraft and pilots are supported through donations, and its primary emphasis is providing medical, logistical, and transportation services to the outer Yap islands. To help fund missions to the outer islands, PMA operates a paid passenger airline service between Palau and Yap, as well as sightseeing and charter services, including contracting work like maritime patrol of Palau's waters for the Australian Government.

The airline operates smaller aircraft than the King Air 200 for Palau sightseeing services. PMA operates Beechcraft Queen Air aircraft , but decided to upgrade to Super King Air aircraft to serve the passenger Palau to Yap route after United Airlines dropped the route.

United Airlines ended its direct service between Koror, Palau (ROR) and Yap (YAP) on January 7, 2018. In response, PMA moved to fill part of the void by acquiring a pair of B200s. Today, the only scheduled flight connections for Yap are the weekly PMA flight to Palau and the twice-weekly United flight to Guam.

PMA's pilot, Amos Collins, told me during the flight that the two turboprop Super King Air 200s were donated by the charity organization, Samaritan's Purse, for a dollar each. Since then, Samaritan's Purse has continued to financially assist in maintaining the aircraft and keeping them viable.

They were previously used as charity bush planes in Kenya and received an overhaul, new avionics, and modifications for PMA service in the Pacific as island hoppers. One of the modifications was retrofitting the aircraft with easily removable seats, allowing for passenger and cargo flexibility.
Beechcraft Super King Air Specs (Per Beechcraft )

With two aircraft, PMA can also run the flights if one aircraft is down for maintenance, and two flights if both are operational when demand requires. The day I flew, the aircraft had to carry a large payload of cargo while also having more than normal passengers. As such, PMA removed two seats from my flight.

This reduced the passenger seats from nine to seven, including me in the co-pilot seat, clearing space for the aircraft to carry more cargo. PMA then added a second flight to carry the rest of the passengers and the cargo. The aircraft cabin is pressurized, allowing passengers to enjoy a comfortable, somewhat intimate flight that feels something similar to a flight-seeing tour.

To check in for the flight, I went to the Palau International Terminal only to find it was closed. After waiting for a while, a van arrived to pick passengers up and take them to PMA's hangar on the other side of the airport. There, I waited in the PMA waiting room that doubled as a check-in facility. PMA checked in passengers for the morning's scenic tour flight before moving on to the international passenger flight.

PMA checked passengers onto the flight to Yap, although no boarding passes were issued. After checking in, passengers were taken by van to the airport terminal and taken through locked doors to the immigration room (backwards). The immigration staff heard us and shouted " coming " before manning the immigration booth and processing the seven passengers.

Having been stamped out of Palau , we returned to the van and drove back to the PMA waiting room for a while before heading over to the hangar. We walked through their maintenance workshop to reach the Super King 200 parked on the apron. The pilot invited me to sit with him in the co-pilot's seat and wear the headset so that we could chat throughout the flight. Taking off in the turboprop was smooth, with one of the highlights being a de facto scenic tour of the Palau islands.

The Super King Air is an excellent aircraft for short-haul flights where passenger demand is for up to nine passengers. The aircraft is considered more capable than a light aircraft. It is often valued as a maritime patrol and fisheries surveillance aircraft, especially for smaller countries like Palau.

One of its top roles is as an air ambulance/MEDEVAC aircraft, which is one of the roles PMA uses it for. It is an excellent aircraft for general utility transport, being able to move passengers and small amounts of cargo. For small Pacific islands, it can carry substantial baggage, a realistic number of passengers for those destinations, and it is able to operate on relatively short runways.

It has the range to serve long island connections, while also coming with a cruise speed of 260–290 knots. The relatively high speed is one of the distinguishing attributes of the aircraft relative to traditional island-hopper aircraft . An Islander may cruise at around 120 knots, adding significant time on routes measuring in the hundreds of nautical miles.
body_zh: 亚伦是一位航空爱好者和环球旅行家，对航空航天历史和技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他曾多次环游世界，经常在旅途中参观航空博物馆和历史飞机收藏。他是新西兰人，是航空专家，并对其他各种学科保持着广泛的兴趣。
Beechcraft 超级空中国王 200 (B200) 双引擎涡轮螺旋桨飞机作为丛林飞机和岛屿直升机很受欢迎，特别是对于较长的岛际航线。我乘坐的超级国王航空 200 是帕劳和雅浦之间的定期客运航班，是这两个在文化和物流上紧密相连的太平洋岛屿之间的唯一航班。
由于该航班绕行关岛国际机场，因此它也是唯一飞往雅浦岛（密克罗尼西亚联邦主要岛屿）且无需通过美国移民局的定期客运航班。
在我的太平洋之旅期间，我还乘坐 PMA 的第二架 B200 往返于雅浦岛外岛的乌利西 (Ulithi) 执行任务。这架飞机的尺寸非常理想，因为它是乌利西小机场能够容纳的最大的商用飞机。让我们来看看比奇超级空中国王 200 的机上生活以及它如何非常适合太平洋的一些岛际客运航线。
为什么 PMA 运营超级空中国王 200 涡轮螺旋桨飞机
2026 年 10 月，我乘坐比奇超级空中国王 200 从太平洋岛国帕劳飞往雅浦（密克罗尼西亚联邦的一部分）。然后于 11 月 2 日乘坐 B200 飞往雅浦外岛乌利西。这些飞机由混合慈善组织太平洋宣教航空 (PMA) 拥有和运营。
PMA 是一家慈善公司，其飞机和飞行员通过捐赠获得支持，其主要重点是为雅浦岛外岛提供医疗、后勤和运输服务。为了资助前往外岛的任务，PMA 运营帕劳和雅浦岛之间的付费客运航空服务，以及观光和包机服务，包括为澳大利亚政府承包帕劳水域海上巡逻等工作。
该航空公司运营比 King Air 200 更小的飞机，提供帕劳观光服务。 PMA 运营比奇女王航空 (Beechcraft Queen Air) 飞机，但在联合航空放弃该航线后，决定升级为超级国王航空 (Super King Air) 飞机，为帕劳至雅浦航线的乘客提供服务。
美国联合航空于 2018 年 1 月 7 日终止了帕劳科罗尔 (ROR) 和雅浦 (YAP) 之间的直航服务。作为回应，PMA 购买了两架 B200 来填补部分空白。如今，前往雅浦岛的唯一定期航班是每周一趟飞往帕劳的 PMA 航班和每周两次飞往关岛的美联航航班。
PMA 的飞行员阿莫斯·柯林斯 (Amos Collins) 在飞行过程中告诉我，两架涡轮螺旋桨超级空中国王 200 飞机是由慈善组织撒玛利亚救援会捐赠的，每架一美元。从那时起，撒玛利亚救援会继续为飞机的维护和维持提供经济援助。
它们之前被用作肯尼亚的慈善丛林飞机，并进行了大修、新的航空电子设备和改装，以作为太平洋岛屿跳跃机的 PMA 服务。其中一项修改是为飞机改装可轻松拆卸的座椅，以实现乘客和货物的灵活性。
Beechcraft 超级空中国王规格（根据 Beechcraft ）
对于两架飞机，如果一架飞机因维护而停机，PMA 还可以运行这些航班；如果两架飞机在需要时都可以运行，PMA 还可以运行两个航班。我飞行的那天，飞机必须运载大量货物，同时还载有比正常情况更多的乘客。因此，PMA 从我的航班上取消了两个座位。
这将乘客座位从九个减少到七个，其中我坐在副驾驶座位上，为飞机腾出了空间来运载更多货物。 PMA 随后增加了第二个航班来运送其余的乘客和货物。飞机机舱是加压的，让乘客享受舒适、亲密的飞行，感觉类似于飞行观光之旅。
为了办理登机手续，我前往帕劳国际航站楼，却发现它已关闭。等了一会后，一辆面包车来接乘客，并将他们带到机场另一边的 PMA 机库。在那里，我在 PMA 候诊室等候，这里也是办理登机手续的地方。 PMA 为早上的风景旅游航班的乘客办理了登机手续，然后转乘国际客运航班。
PMA 检查了飞往雅浦航班的乘客，但没有发放登机牌。办理登机手续后，乘客被面包车带到机场航站楼，然后通过上锁的门进入出入境检查室（向后）。移民局工作人员听到我们的声音，大喊“来了”，然后就在移民局接待了七名乘客。
离开帕劳后，我们回到车上，开回 PMA 候诊室一段时间，然后前往机库。我们穿过他们的维修车间，到达停在停机坪上的Super King 200。飞行员邀请我和他一起坐在副驾驶座位上，并戴上耳机，这样我们就可以在整个飞行过程中聊天。涡轮螺旋桨飞机的起飞很顺利，亮点之一是帕劳群岛的事实上的风景旅游。
超级国王航空是一款出色的短途航班飞机，乘客需求最多可容纳 9 名乘客。该飞机被认为比轻型飞机更有能力。它通常被视为海上巡逻和渔业监视飞机，特别是对于帕劳这样的小国来说。
其最重要的角色之一是作为空中救护/医疗后送飞机，这也是 PMA 使用它的角色之一。它是一款出色的通用运输飞机，能够运送乘客和少量货物。对于太平洋小岛屿，它可以携带大量行李、前往这些目的地的实际乘客数量，并且能够在相对较短的跑道上运行。
它的航程范围可以为长岛连接提供服务，同时巡航速度为 260-290 节。相对于传统的跳岛飞机，相对较高的速度是该飞机的显着特征之一。岛民可以以 120 节左右的速度巡航，从而在数百海里的航线上增加大量时间。

title_en: Etihad Slashes Flights, Pulls Airbus A380 Off Two Routes (Including Toronto)
title_zh: 阿提哈德航空大幅削减航班，并取消两条航线（包括多伦多）的空客 A380
summary: Etihad has filed an early 2027 schedule update cutting frequencies on about two dozen routes and pulling the A380 from Toronto and Singapore, as questions swirl around its commercial strategy.
summary_zh: 阿提哈德航空已提交 2027 年初时刻表更新，削减约 20 条航线的班次，并取消从多伦多和新加坡起飞的 A380
body_en: Etihad Airways has just filed a major schedule update for early 2027, impacting a couple of dozen routes. In isolation, you might not think much of this, as the first several weeks of the year have weaker demand in many markets. However, in light of what’s going on in Etihad’s commercial division, I can’t help but be curious if there’s a bit more to this, and wonder how things will evolve.
Etihad reduces capacity in many markets in early 2027

AeroRoutes reports on how Abu Dhabi-based Etihad has filed a schedule change for the first quarter of 2027, with most of the changes taking place for flights as of January 11, 2027. For the most part, the reductions are for around a couple of months, through March 2027. There are two ways to look at this
This could just reflect that January (at least after the first week) and February tend to be pretty slow months for long haul travel

This could more accurately reflect the reality of the reduced demand Etihad is currently dealing with, given geopolitical issues, but the airline is only progressively making schedule changes, and these could be extended into the spring as well
The frequency reductions we’re seeing are pretty significant. Just to look at service to North America
Boston (BOS) flights are being reduced from 7x weekly to 4x weekly
Charlotte (CLT) flights are being reduced from 7x weekly to 4x weekly
Chicago (ORD) flights are being reduced from 5x weekly to 4x weekly
Toronto (YYZ) flights are being downgraded from the A380 to the A350

Specific to the A380, it seems that Etihad is taking the jet off the Toronto and Singapore (SIN) routes over that period, and it doesn’t seem like the super jumbo will be flying any other routes in place of that, at least based on current schedule filings. During that period, Etihad will only be flying the A380 to four destinations — Bangkok (BKK), London (LHR), Paris (CDG), and Tokyo Narita (NRT).
I’m curious how Etihad’s commercial strategy evolves

It’s a fascinating time for Etihad. Obviously Gulf carriers are having a rather difficult time with everything going on in the region at the moment, and it comes at a unique time for Etihad, as the carrier has been going through a massive expansion.

Now, I’ve been a bit skeptical about the claimed economics of this expansion, but Etihad management has insisted everything couldn’t be better… until Etihad Chief Commercial Officer Arik De recently “departed” the airline .

The can of worms that this departure opened is truly unlike anything I’ve seen at any airline before… and I’ve been following this industry for a long time. Seriously, check out the 520+ comments on my post about his departure , because employees have a lot to say. It’s so salacious that it has gotten OMAAT blocked in the UAE .

The point is, if even a quarter of the things are to be believed — and I’ve had some very interesting conversations with some formerly very high up people at the airline — then the carrier’s entire commercial strategy has been a bit questionable, to put it politely, and more about serving a certain someone’s LinkedIn profile ego, rather than actually developing a commercial strategy.

So with him no longer there, I’m curious to see how this all evolves. Let me emphasize that this is of course in no way a knock on all the hardworking employees at Etihad who have had to endure this “leadership” for too long. It seems like they now have quite the web to untangle, especially given the toxic people who are reportedly still there.

Etihad Airways has just filed a pretty big schedule change for early 2027, whereby a couple of dozen routes are seeing significant capacity reductions. Most notably, the Airbus A380 is being taken off of both the Toronto and Singapore routes.

In isolation, you might not think much of this, as demand is often a little lighter earlier in the year. But what I find interesting is that this follows a period of very rapid expansion, along with the carrier’s head of commercial strategy getting the boot.

Based on what I’ve heard from a countless number of current and former Etihad management employees, the strategy of the past couple of years hasn’t been as sound as a certain someone has tried to make it appear. We’ll see how this all unravels.
body_zh: 阿提哈德航空刚刚提交了 2027 年初的重大时刻表更新，影响了数十条航线。孤立地看，您可能不会对此想太多，因为今年前几周许多市场的需求疲软。然而，鉴于阿提哈德商业部门正在发生的事情，我不禁很好奇是否还有更多内容，并想知道事情将如何演变。
阿提哈德将于 2027 年初减少许多市场的运力
AeroRoutes 报道了总部位于阿布扎比的阿提哈德航空如何提交 2027 年第一季度的航班时刻表变更，其中大部分变更是针对截至 2027 年 1 月 11 日的航班进行的。在大多数情况下，航班减少的时间约为几个月，直至 2027 年 3 月。有两种方式来看待这一问题
这可能只是反映出一月（至少在第一周之后）和二月对于长途旅行来说往往是相当缓慢的月份
鉴于地缘政治问题，这可以更准确地反映阿提哈德航空目前正在应对的需求减少的现实，但该航空公司只是逐步调整航班时刻表，而且这些调整也可能会延续到春季
我们看到的频率降低非常显着。只是为了看看北美的服务
波士顿 (BOS) 航班从每周 7 趟减少至每周 4 趟
夏洛特 (CLT) 航班从每周 7 趟减少至每周 4 趟
芝加哥 (ORD) 航班从每周 5 趟减少至每周 4 趟
多伦多 (YYZ) 航班从 A380 降级为 A350
具体到 A380，阿提哈德似乎正在取消该飞机在此期间的多伦多和新加坡 (SIN) 航线，而且这架超级大型飞机似乎不会执飞任何其他航线来代替该航线，至少根据目前的时刻表文件来看是这样。在此期间，阿提哈德航空将仅使用 A380 飞往四个目的地：曼谷 (BKK)、伦敦 (LHR)、巴黎 (CDG) 和东京成田 (NRT)。
我很好奇阿提哈德的商业战略如何演变
对于阿提哈德航空来说，这是一个令人着迷的时刻。显然，海湾航空公司目前正经历一段相当困难的时期，因为该地区目前正在发生的一切，这对阿提哈德来说是一个独特的时刻，因为该航空公司一直在经历大规模扩张。
现在，我对这种扩张所声称的经济效益有点怀疑，但阿提哈德管理层坚称一切再好不过了……直到阿提哈德首席商务官 Arik De 最近“离开”了该航空公司。
这次出发所引发的蠕虫罐确实不同于我之前在任何航空公司见过的任何东西……而且我已经关注这个行业很长时间了。说真的，看看我的帖子上关于他离职的 520 多条评论，因为员工有很多话要说。它是如此淫荡，以至于 OMAAT 在阿联酋被屏蔽。
关键是，如果即使四分之一的事情是可信的——我与航空公司的一些前高层人士进行了一些非常有趣的对话——那么礼貌地说，该航空公司的整个商业策略就有点值得怀疑，更多的是服务于某个人的 LinkedIn 个人资料的自我，而不是真正制定商业策略。
因此，随着他不再存在，我很好奇这一切会如何演变。我要强调的是，这当然不是对阿提哈德所有辛勤工作的员工的打击，他们不得不长期忍受这种“领导”。看来他们现在有足够的网络来解开，特别是考虑到据报道有毒的人仍然在那里。
阿提哈德航空刚刚对 2027 年初的航班时刻表进行了相当大的调整，其中数十条航线的运力大幅减少。最值得注意的是，空中客车 A380 将从多伦多和新加坡航线起飞。
孤立地看，您可能不会对此想太多，因为今年早些时候的需求通常会比较少。但我发现有趣的是，这是在一段非常快速的扩张时期之后发生的，同时该航空公司的商业战略主管也被解雇了。
根据我从无数现任和前任阿提哈德管理员工那里听到的消息，过去几年的战略并不像某些人试图表现的那样健全。我们将看看这一切如何展开。

summary_zh: 在长达 15 年的合作伙伴关系下，列日机场已将其燃油储存、卡车调度和飞机加油业务转移到单一数字平台上
body_en: Liège Airport digitises aircraft refuelling in 15-year deal with i6 Group - Aviation24.be
Home Airports Liège Airport (LGG) Liège Airport digitises aircraft refuelling in 15-year deal with i6 Group

Liège Airport has brought its fuel storage, truck dispatch and aircraft refuelling operations onto a single digital platform under a 15-year partnership with i6 Group. The system tracks fuel in real time from storage tank to aircraft wing.

Refuelling teams use mobile devices connected directly to fuel meters. Operators must validate checks at each stage, while dispatchers can see fuel requests, deliveries and stock levels in the same system. The airport says this will improve traceability and reduce manual errors. The platform also feeds data into the airport’s other systems and is intended to support future fuel deliveries by barge.

The rollout covers the entire fuel operation at Liège, where the airport is the sole provider of fuel storage and aircraft refuelling. Liège handled more than 1.3 million tonnes of freight across 29,000 cargo flights in 2025.

title_en: Buy IHG One Rewards Points With 100% Bonus (0.5 Cents Each): Worth It?
title_zh: 购买IHG One Rewards积分并获得100%奖励（每次0.5美分） ：值得吗？
summary: IHG One Rewards is offering a 100% bonus on purchased points through November 10, 2026, bringing the cost to 0.5 cents each. Here's when buying makes sense.

body_en: IHG One Rewards is currently offering a limited time 100% bonus on purchased points. With this, IHG One Rewards members can purchase points for as little as 0.5 cents each. Is this a good deal?

While I wouldn’t recommend buying points without a specific use in mind, there are absolutely ways to get outsized value, and this is in line with the best offers that we see from the program. With the right strategy, this could be an opportunity to get a significant discount on an IHG hotel stay, and I’ll show exactly how.
Link: Buy IHG One Rewards points with this promotion with a 100% bonus

Between 12:01AM ET on November 11 and 11:59PM ET on November 15, 2026, IHG One Rewards is offering a bonus on purchased points . Points can be purchased in increments of 1,000 points, and the bonus is structured as follows
Buy 5,000-200,000 points, receive a 100% bonus
Note that the purchase of IHG points doesn’t count toward elite status, and purchased points will post within 72 hours of an eligible purchase (though usually much faster than that).
Ordinarily you can buy IHG One Rewards points for as little as one cent each (the pricing isn’t linear), before any discounts or bonuses, and that’s inclusive of all taxes and fees.

With that in mind, if you were eligible for a 100% bonus and purchased 200,000 IHG One Rewards points pre-bonus, you’d receive a total of 400,000 points at a cost of $2,000, which is a rate of 0.5 cents per IHG point.

While The Brand New IHG One Rewards Premier Select Credit Card ( learn more ), The New IHG One Rewards Premier Credit Card ( learn more ), The New IHG One Rewards Credit Card ( learn more ), and The New IHG One Rewards Business Credit Card ( learn more ), offer a 30% discount on purchased points, that benefit only applies when buying points at the normal cost, and wouldn’t be applicable here.
IHG One Rewards ordinarily lets members purchase up to 150,000 points per calendar year, before any bonuses. However, during this promotion that cap has been increased to 200,000 points, pre-bonus.
How does this compare to other IHG buy points promotions?

When IHG One Rewards does offer a promotion on purchased points, the 100% bonus or 50% discount is the most common offer. A 100% bonus and 50% discount give you the same price per point, so you’ll typically pay 0.5 cents per point during a promotion.
Below is a chart with some of the recent promotions we saw from the program, before this one.

IHG One Rewards points purchases are processed by points.com, meaning they don’t count as a hotel purchase for the purposes of credit card spending. That means if you pay with an IHG credit card, you wouldn’t earn any bonus rewards, so it’s not treated as if it’s IHG spending.

Therefore I’d recommend using a card on which you’re trying to reach a minimum spending requirement , or otherwise, a credit card that maximizes your return on everyday spending . See this post for more on which credit cards are best for buying points.

IHG One Rewards has dynamic award pricing, which means there’s no minimum or maximum number of points a hotel stay can cost. Rather, the cost of an award stay generally correlates somewhat to the cost of a revenue stay.

However, that doesn’t necessarily mean you’ll get the same value with all hotel stays. There are many situations where you can get outsized value by buying points and then redeeming them. Let me just give a few examples, using stays I pulled up for random dates (again, pricing is dynamic, so this won’t reflect what you see every day).
For example, the Six Senses Kyoto is bookable for 165,000 points per night, and you could purchase those points for $825.
That represents massive savings over the cash cost, which is $1,493.
